statements.mission: Make surfing a sport you can learn — one sequence, one game, one belt at a time; accessible to anyone willing to put in time and effort.
statements.vision: Be for surfing what PADI is for diving — the standard.
statements.essence: The ocean has no manual. The Surf Sequence does.

document.use: dashboards, student records, intake, front desk, email, decks, print, the manual

portal.use: Course, sequence pages, Let's Play, Home

rules: technical notation only — never branding or marketing
command words are set in Paper or Ink with a coloured dot in front; never rainbow text
a colour never replaces the word
hold is drawn beside the line, never as a segment of it
pocket is a place, not a command

threeCircles.rule: own family; Board #FFDC33 is NOT Projection #FFD600

footPositions.rule: pastels; live inside the board figure only

pop.rule: UI status feedback only; never branding

globalRules: cyan is a precise accent or one large scale moment, never wallpaper

wordmark.rule: logo artwork only — never loaded as a UI font

screen.title: Archivo 900 expanded uppercase 36px/1.08
screen.subtitle: Archivo 600 17px/1.35
screen.label: IBM Plex Mono 500 uppercase 12px
screen.rule: reading headings never become full uppercase paragraphs

spacing.rule: Fibonacci only; never invent intermediate values

geometry.rule: print and editorial are square; the digital product uses 8/5

approvedVersions: monochrome for embroidery, single-colour print and legal
logo.clearSpace: 1× the spiral's smallest Fibonacci square, all sides
misuse: never flip — wave direction is fixed
no square, badge or boxed version
never scale fixed figure rasters above native size
logo.appTile: the rounded tile is an operating-system container, not a logo

messageHierarchy.method: Train with intention. Learn with structure.

learningModel.mission: ONE execution on a real wave (perception-action coupling)
learningModel.criteria: affordances the surfer learns to see
learningModel.coach: confirms in the water; skill self-organises

sequence: Do it — the mission, one execution, no counting
Review — indicators, common mistakes, how it felt
sequenceRules: the sequence is the unit of teaching
the plan is made before the water and is not graded
opening a card or changing a foot position never records progress or completes a lesson
the execution and the two-way review ARE recorded
no level is granted from land work

prch.rule: taught in original form; 'Compact' is a coaching alias only; P·R·C·H is the language, colours only solidify it

zones.pocket: marked in the corner where the wave breaks

footPositions.P2: neutral — balance, stability, speed; the default

vibes.rule: attitude in the water; never tied to a belt, never an evaluation criterion

constitutional: named expressions (Cruz, Tapaloco, Grenade, Choke, Elbow) are never renamed or translated
belt names, four pillars and EDPF are constitutional

openQuestions: Card surface drift: implementation ships #F3F0E5 / #F8F5EC, manual specifies #E9E2D2 / #F7F9FA. Follow the manual unless editing existing portal code. Flag, do not silently pick.
Manual 9.6: whether rail change earns its own marker — undefined.
Manual 9.6: exact duration of a hold — undefined.
TSS High Performance identity — unresolved; do not design for it without asking.
